universal.label: Raised by
universal.desc: Who is filing this ticket — sets member-facing vs internal tone and who gets the update.

universal.label: How this reached us
universal.desc: Which channel the report arrived on — it decides the reply route and what proof exists.

universal.label: Reporter name
universal.desc: Full name of the person who raised it, exactly as they want to be addressed.

universal.label: Reporter email or phone
universal.desc: Best callback channel. Used for the SLA clock's first outbound response.

universal.label: Preferred contact channel
universal.desc: Channel for status updates. Mirrors ticketInputSchema.preferredContact in the Iris contract.

universal.label: Where the member wants the answer
universal.desc: Only a channel the reporter actually gave us.

universal.label: Studio
universal.desc: Site the issue belongs to. Drives room list, ownership split and Momence location lookup.

universal.label: Area / room
universal.desc: Room within the studio. Options are filtered to that studio's room plan (studioAreasFor).

universal.label: Date & time of occurrence
universal.desc: When it actually happened (not when it was typed). Anchors CCTV, class-session and roster lookups.

universal.label: How recent?
universal.desc: Fast picker for floor staff filing from a phone. Verbatim OCCURRED_OPTIONS from the hub.

universal.label: Class format
universal.desc: Which offering the ticket is about. Verbatim CLASS_FORMATS list, 24 formats.
universal.condText: Yes — if a class is involved

universal.label: Class date & slot
universal.desc: Session date and start time; lets ops pull the Momence session roster behind this complaint.

universal.label: Trainer on session
universal.desc: Named trainer for that slot. Verbatim TRAINERS roster (20).
universal.condText: Yes — if class or trainer involved

universal.label: Members affected (count)
universal.desc: 0 = no member impact, internal-only. Drives the escalation and comms decision.
universal.condText: Yes — if more than one member

universal.label: Is this a repeat of a previous issue?
universal.desc: Repeat of an open/closed ticket jumps the queue and pulls the prior ticket into the thread.

universal.label: Related ticket ID
universal.desc: Prior ticket number, e.g. TKT-27C18254. Prevents duplicate SLA clocks running on one fault.
universal.condText: Yes — if is_repeat = 'Yes, ticket already open'

universal.label: Impact on member
universal.desc: inferPriority() floors the ticket to high whenever this is 'Yes', whatever the reporter wrote.
universal.condText: No — required whenever a member or class is named

universal.label: Did it block or degrade a class?
universal.desc: Feeds isClassImpacted in the router, which forces priority >= high.
universal.condText: Yes — if class_format or class_date is filled

universal.label: Immediate danger to anyone?
universal.desc: Feeds isImmediateDanger — any 'Yes' forces critical and pages the L1 immediately.

universal.label: Photos / video / audio
universal.desc: Evidence. A/C noise or music faults need a 10-second clip; damage needs a wide + close photo.
universal.condText: Yes — required for all damage, hygiene, safety and equipment issues
universal.placeholder: jpg, png, mp4, mp3 · max 25 MB each

universal.label: Ticket title
universal.desc: One line, auto-drafted from Category + Sub category + Studio + Area; reporter may edit.

universal.label: What happened (summary)
universal.desc: Two to four sentences in the reporter's own words. Enforced minimum 12 chars by the ticket schema.

universal.label: Requested resolution
universal.desc: What the reporter wants to walk away with — fixes the compensation conversation before it starts.

universal.label: Member sentiment
universal.desc: Matches the sentiment enum in the ticket contract.

universal.label: Churn risk
universal.desc: Retention flag that Shifa's lapsed-client follow-ups key off.

cycleParts.name: SIC2 Console
cycleParts.description: Top-mounted console with ANT+ power display. Secured by 3mm hex screws via the power wire channel.

cycleParts.name: SPM2 Power Meter
cycleParts.description: Crank-arm power meter. ANT+ 5-digit ID. Battery spacer or taped AA batteries. Zero reset ADC must read 790–990.

cycleParts.name: FitLoc Lever & Handlebar Stem
cycleParts.description: Quick-release lever for handlebar height adjustment. Insert handlebar post, push lever down to lock.

cycleParts.name: Fore/Aft Slide Knob
cycleParts.description: Adjusts horizontal saddle position along the rail.

cycleParts.name: Resistance / Brake Knob
cycleParts.description: Controls magnetic eddy-current braking force. Press down for emergency stop.

cycleParts.name: SprintShift Lever
cycleParts.description: Multi-stage quick shift for instant resistance jumps during sprints.

cycleParts.name: Flywheel
cycleParts.description: Perimeter-weighted aluminum flywheel with magnetic eddy-current brake.

cycleParts.name: Pedal CR-L (Left)
cycleParts.description: Left pedal — REVERSE THREADED. Turn CLOCKWISE to remove, counterclockwise to install.

cycleParts.name: Pedal CR-R (Right)
cycleParts.description: Right pedal — standard thread. Turn counterclockwise to remove, clockwise to install.

cycleParts.name: Saddle Height Clamp
cycleParts.description: Clamp securing the seatpost at the desired height.

cycleParts.name: Stabilizers (Front/Rear)
cycleParts.description: Front: wheels facing forward. Rear: step plates with sloped edge pointing away. M10 bolts. 4 leveling feet with 14mm nut.

cycleParts.name: Belt Drive
cycleParts.description: Poly-V belt connecting pedal crank to flywheel. Vibration or slipping requires technician service.

cycleParts.name: Crank Arm
cycleParts.description: Connects pedals to the flywheel via the bottom bracket. SPM2 power meter is integrated here.

cycleTroubleshooting.diagnosis: Brake pad or flywheel housing misalignment. Possible loose flywheel bolt.
cycleTroubleshooting.action: Immediately take bike out of rotation. Do NOT ride. Schedule technician inspection.

cycleTroubleshooting.diagnosis: FitLoc cam mechanism worn or post not inserted deep enough.
cycleTroubleshooting.action: Check post insertion depth (min line visible). If still slipping, tag bike for FitLoc replacement.

cycleTroubleshooting.symptom: Power meter not pairing / no watts displayed
cycleTroubleshooting.diagnosis: ANT+ pairing failure or dead batteries in SPM2.
cycleTroubleshooting.action: 1. Check/replace AA batteries (use spacer or tape). 2. Re-pair using 5-digit ANT+ ID on console. 3. If still dead, check power wire channel connection.

cycleTroubleshooting.diagnosis: SPM2 zero offset out of range. May indicate mechanical stress on crank arm.
cycleTroubleshooting.action: Re-attempt zero reset with NO weight on pedals. If ADC reads outside 790–990 after 3 attempts, remove and reseat crank arm at 52–57 N·m. Escalate to Stages support if persistent.

cycleTroubleshooting.diagnosis: Pedal has unscrewed from the crank arm — most often the left (CR-L) pedal, which is REVERSE threaded and works loose if it was never torqued to spec.
cycleTroubleshooting.action: Take the bike out of rotation immediately — a pedal that can detach is a rider-safety fault. Refit at 42 N·m with a 15mm pedal wrench (left pedal: turn CLOCKWISE to tighten). Inspect the crank-arm threads; if they are stripped, replace the crank arm (8mm hex, 52–57 N·m).

cycleTroubleshooting.diagnosis: Pedal threads stripped or cross-threaded. Remember: left pedal is REVERSE threaded.
cycleTroubleshooting.action: Do NOT force. Remove pedal, inspect threads. If crank arm threads are stripped, replace crank arm (8mm hex, 52–57 N·m). Apply grease to threads before reinstall.

cycleTroubleshooting.diagnosis: Power wire disconnected or console battery dead.
cycleTroubleshooting.action: 1. Check power wire in channel under handlebar. 2. Replace console batteries. 3. Reseat 3mm hex screws. If still dead, replace SIC2 console unit.

cycleTroubleshooting.diagnosis: Belt tension loss or misalignment. Normal wear after heavy usage.
cycleTroubleshooting.action: Take bike out of rotation. Belt tensioning requires trained technician. Do not attempt field adjustment.

cycleTroubleshooting.symptom: Resistance knob not engaging / no resistance change
cycleTroubleshooting.diagnosis: Magnetic brake pad gap too wide or brake knob cable disconnected.
cycleTroubleshooting.action: Check brake knob cable routing under shroud. If cable intact, brake pad gap needs technician adjustment.

cycleTroubleshooting.diagnosis: Stabilizer feet not leveled or stabilizer bolts loose.
cycleTroubleshooting.action: Adjust 4 leveling feet (14mm nut) until all contact the floor evenly. Tighten M10 stabilizer bolts (6mm hex + 17mm wrench).

cycleTroubleshooting.diagnosis: Saddle clamp not tightened or clamp mechanism worn.
cycleTroubleshooting.action: Tighten saddle clamp with 13mm wrench. If clamp is worn/stripped, replace the clamp assembly.

cycleTroubleshooting.diagnosis: SprintShift cable binding or lever mechanism jammed.
cycleTroubleshooting.action: Check cable routing. If lever mechanism is jammed, take bike out of rotation for technician service.
